messages.content: You summarize texts. Answer with the summary only.

content.text:
Summarize the following text in at most 25 words.

Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity. Homes with panels on the roof can cut their power bills, and any extra energy can be sold back to the grid. Panels last for about twenty-five years and need little care, but they produce less power on cloudy days and nothing at night, so many owners add a battery.

message.content: Solar panels convert sunlight to electricity, cutting home bills; excess can be sold. They last ~25 years, require little care, but need batteries for nighttime.
